design.title: Causal role-sharing encoder with softly supervised control phases
design.coverage_gap: Only diagonal LL/HH demonstrations couple peg and box positions. A monolithic representation can use box_y as a proxy for where to grasp and peg_y as a proxy for where to transport. Acquisition and insertion also occupy different observation/action regimes despite continuous raw coordinates.
design.reusable_regularity: One learned edge encoder is shared between hand-to-pegGrasp and pegHead-to-goal relations, with explicit role tags. A small causal four-phase classifier softly gates the two relation embeddings and their direct metric errors. It learns open approach, closure, transport and lateral/vertical alignment proxies from the same demonstrations. A separate world encoder and direct world skips preserve constraints outside local relations. This is a learned conditional representation, not an expert switch or multi-policy controller: all actions still come from one common action4 diffusion U-Net.
dependencies_preserved: World hand and goal positions remain direct conditioning channels as well as inputs to the world encoder; box placement, robot workspace and gravity are retained.
No coordinate rotation is imposed: signed xyz edge vectors, source/target heights and yz alignment preserve the fixed insertion axis.
Both role streams remain nonzero (gate floor 0.15), including during uncertain closure, so box/obstacle context is not removed in an early stage.

Aperture and previous aperture, current/previous xyzw object quaternions, observed hand/peg displacements and the head-grasp offset retain temporal/contact/tool dependencies. Carry-edge source motion uses pegGrasp displacement as a translation proxy; the two actual pegHead history positions and orientation information remain in conditioning through the two relation inputs.
Object2 is omitted because the public schema declares it absent. There is no inferred box simulator state or runtime contact flag.

evidence_refs.use: Exact N20 source boundary, with no other support or evaluation states.
LL/HH versus C/E coverage, world action/control semantics, site names and state slices.
10 LL/10 HH support; inspected episode summaries show aperture minima around 0.293 and gripper action extremes -1 and +0.6.
Actual frame shows the gripper approaching the peg away from the box.
Actual frame shows the low acquisition configuration, distinct from insertion.
Another actual support frame shows the gripper at the tabletop peg.
Actual support frame shows the peg held near the side opening.
Aperture declines from 0.825 at t40 to 0.346 at t51; transport actions begin near t51, followed by yz alignment. This motivates a coarse 0.36 aperture proxy, not a contact/success threshold.
Different hand-to-peg lateral relation in HH despite the same reset hand.
Learned modules in build_modules; future/label isolation and auxiliary interface.
Training-only named targets, current-window mask and unchanged action epsilon objective.

expected_failure_signature: If aperture is an unreliable holding proxy off support, predicted carry probability may rise for an empty grasp; expected result is transport without the peg or a premature retreat from acquisition.
If the learned phase classifier uses correlated goal position instead of local closure geometry, closure timing will change across C cells even at a similar hand-to-peg state.
The soft gate may still blend acquisition and transport near a transition; early box motion or delayed insertion is the falsifiable boundary failure.
World skips deliberately prevent false invariance but can retain layout shortcuts. Edge-weight sharing may underfit the role-specific distinction between grasp approach and side insertion.

required_runtime_fields.raw_history: [B,2,42] causal_context raw_history. Each row uses hand 0:3, aperture 3:4, pegGrasp 4:7, quaternion xyzw 7:11, previous hand 18:21, previous aperture 21:22, previous pegGrasp 22:25, previous quaternion 25:29, goal 36:39 and pegHead 39:42.
required_runtime_fields.causal_stage: All four logits and probabilities are predicted solely from each causal observation's geometry, finite differences and aperture. No labels, episode ID, time index, masks or future states enter condition/denoise.
required_runtime_fields.action_semantics: Identity encode/decode: world dx/dy/dz with 0.01 m native scale plus untouched scalar gripper; public clipping and four-of-sixteen execution only.
required_runtime_fields.normalization: Fixed 0.1 m relation/height and 0.5 m world scales; displacements divided by native 0.01 m. No support-fitted deployment state or weights outside the joint optimizer.

training_only_targets.name: control_phase
training_only_targets.source: For each (episode,t) from exact D_N, native actions[t,3] and obs[t] only: class0 if gripper command<0; otherwise class1 if aperture>0.36; otherwise class2 if norm(goal_yz-pegHead_yz)>0.035 m; otherwise class3. These are coarse control-phase proxy labels, not successful-contact or evaluator-success ground truth.
training_only_targets.shape: One integer label per chunk-start window.
training_only_targets.loss: 0.15 times cross entropy on predicted current-observation phase logits, reduction none, multiplied by batch mask[:,0], divided by its valid-start sum clamped to one. Nonnegative and separately normalized. No new loss on the action predictions and no action reweighting.
training_only_targets.inference: No label cache and no training mask at runtime; predicted phases alone condition the DP.

design.change_summary: Initial independent scientific design: shared 21->64->32 relation MLP, 18->48->16 world MLP, 21->48->4 causal phase MLP, 119-dimensional per-observation conditioning and one unchanged common action4 U-Net. Add only masked phase cross entropy; common epsilon action loss remains weight 1 / (mask.sum()*4). No structural repairs or performance feedback at authoring.
